scope: Frozen development measurement of unchanged camera-compensated moving source-track fragments on three reused UVY clips

camera.samples: Zero-based range(0, nativeFrameCount, 12) union {nativeFrameCount - 1}; independent of labels
camera.method: estimateAffinePartial2D current-to-first-anchor, RANSAC, default refinement; ORB seed 0 and one OpenCV thread
camera.personMask: All cached proposal boxes expanded by 10 percent of each box width and height, clipped to reference image
camera.anchor: First frame identity retained as in previous Dimitrov motion diagnostic; does not independently satisfy distributed-match gates
camera.nativeConjugation: S @ reduced3x3 @ inverse(S), S = diag(nativeWidth/referenceWidth, nativeHeight/referenceHeight, 1)

observations.identityScope: Cached ByteTrack temporal source fragment, not verified person identity
observations.raw640AndRaw1024Forbidden: Their IDs restart by row on every frame and cannot support motion tracks
observations.adaptation: Preserve id, box and confidence exactly as sourceTrackId, bbox and confidence; courtRole null; participantStatus UNKNOWN
observations.selection: Actual observed eligible moving fragments only; unchanged selector abstains when more than two cooccur

scoring.matcher: Unchanged src/evaluation/detection_metrics.py::match_detections; maximum valid cardinality then IoU
scoring.groundTruthOrder: Byte-integrity binding before launch; semantic publisher annotations parsed only after all three unchanged-selector outputs are persisted
scoring.proposalReplay: Require exact historical matched, missed and unmatched_proposals counts for every cached frame, plus all report totals
scoring.unmatchedSelectedMeaning: Publisher-unmatched diagnostic; not validated participant false positives or detector precision
scoring.refereeOverlapMeaning: Separate IoU agreement with publisher referee boxes; not exhaustive moving-official negatives

knownLabelDefectsRetained.defect: Original class1 identity9 is an umpire

dataGrouping.tennis_V01: Federer-Nishikori Wimbledon 2019 quarterfinal potential shared match group
dataGrouping.tennis_V02: Same potential shared match group as tennis_V01

reviews: Exact native PNGs and separate native overlays for first/mid/last, known flawed-label frames, first publisher-unmatched selection, first lost matched proposal, and first ambiguity; indices chosen only after selections are persisted
limitations: Motion supports image observations but does not prove active tennis participation; moving officials or spectators can qualify and stationary players can be missed.
Sparse background registrations and reused flawed publisher labels cannot qualify camera, participant identity, precision, physical speed, court geometry or 3D accuracy.
The original tracked proposal ceiling includes localization misses and fragmented identities; observations are neither regenerated nor filled.
This bounded whole-clip prototype is not a full-match storage or inference benchmark.
Old court-role outputs used different inference inputs and are context, not a controlled comparison using these exact cached observations.
